name: io.github.Servosity/connectwise-automate-mcp
title: ConnectWise Automate MCP
description: Sync your ConnectWise Automate fleet to local SQLite and answer cross-client RMM questions offline.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_SERVER. Set it only to point at a different host.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Registered integration clientId GUID, sent as the clientId header (required for v2020.11+).

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Your Automate host, e.g. company.hostedrmm.com (endpoint base URL).

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the ConnectWise Automate API (short-lived; mint with apitoken mint).

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectWise Automate requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
